name: Editorial Motion Explainer
visual_style: Modern editorial explainer with vector graphics, maps, layered photography, typography and clear data visualization.
camera: Controlled 2D zooms, pans, push-ins and infographic transitions.
lighting: Flat editorial visual treatment with restrained textures and shadows.
motion: Purposeful reveals and easing synced to explanation; prioritize legibility.
consistency: Maintain subject identity, geometry, wardrobe, environment and all distinctive details across frames. Avoid morphing, duplicate limbs, unwanted object changes and camera jumps.
negative_guidance: Avoid flicker, temporal inconsistency, deformations, unnatural body motion, random text, unintended logos and watermarks.
